correctness.rationale: A complete proof is supplied: every cyclic length-three window contains an aligned complementary pair; this forbids circular palindromes of odd lengths at least five. Both start parities of length-2t factors have explicit injective substitution maps; palindrome/antipalindrome predicates reduce exactly to antipalindrome/palindrome input. The only duplicate images arise at length two and are exactly 01 and 10. Summed recurrences and base cases give the closed formulas at every rank. Independently enumerated circular factor sets at ranks one through nine confirm all recurrences, not serve as infinite proof.
